They are really just focused at my workplace with the other servers and regulars, and haven't spread to other areas of my life, though the stress of it is very constant.\n\nDoctor: Have you experienced any episodes where you felt like you were receiving special messages or had a special mission, or have your beliefs about the plot against you been fairly consistent and focused on the idea that others are out to harm you?\n\nPatient: No, I don't have any special mission or get any messages like that. My thoughts are really consistent and just focused on my job, where I have this strong gut feeling that they are trying to ruin things for me and get me fired. It's just about them trading looks and trying to make me look bad.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever taken any actions based on these beliefs, such as confronting your coworkers or trying to gather evidence of the plot, or have you been able to maintain a distance from these thoughts and recognize they might not be based in reality?\n\nPatient: I haven't openly confronted my coworkers about it, but I find it completely impossible to distance myself from these thoughts. Even when my manager shows me proof that there's nothing wrong with the order tickets, I still feel deep down in my gut that there is a hidden plan to get me fired.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had a period of time where you did not believe people were plotting against you at work, or has this belief been constant over the past four months?\n\nPatient: No, it has been completely constant over the last four months and hasn't really gone away at all. It's just about them trading looks and trying to make me look bad.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever taken any actions based on these beliefs, such as confronting your coworkers or trying to gather evidence of the plot, or have you been able to maintain a distance from these thoughts and recognize they might not be based in reality?\n\nPatient: I haven't openly confronted my coworkers about it, but I find it completely impossible to distance myself from these thoughts. Even when my manager shows me proof that there's nothing wrong with the order tickets, I still feel deep down in my gut that there is a hidden plan to get me fired.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had a period of time where you did not believe people were plotting against you at work, or has this belief been constant over the past four months?\n\nPatient: No, it has been completely constant over the last four months and hasn't really gone away at all. Even when my manager tries to show me there's nothing wrong with the tickets, I still feel deep down in my gut that they're plotting to get me fired. It's just there every single shift I work.\n\nDoctor: Have you experienced any significant impairment in your social or occupational functioning as a result of these beliefs, such as difficulty interacting with coworkers or performing your job duties?\n\nPatient: Yes, my work has slipped so much that I’ve been written up several times and almost fired. Outside of work, I’m avoiding my friends and letting my husband handle all the bills, errands, and talking to family because I just feel too overwhelmed to keep up.\n\nDoctor: Have you experienced any hallucinations, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others cannot, in addition to your beliefs about the plot against you at work?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do hear things quite often, especially at work and late at night. I'll hear my name being called or a couple of voices whispering that I'm screwing things up and don't deserve my job, even when I can see the kitchen is quiet and there's nobody near me.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe the voices you hear in more detail, such as how often they occur, what they say, and if they comment on your thoughts or actions?\n\nPatient: They happen pretty regularly, especially over the last four months, mostly when I'm at work or late at night when everything is quiet. The voices whisper my name and say things like I'm screwing up and don't deserve my job. It's really unsettling because I'll hear them clearly even when there is absolutely nobody around me.\n\nDoctor: Have you noticed any significant changes in your behavior or thinking patterns over the past four months, such as becoming more disorganized or having difficulty making decisions?\n\nPatient: Yes, things have definitely gotten a lot more chaotic and hard to manage over the last few months. It's more that when I get overwhelmed, my mind just goes completely blank and I freeze up.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how the voices you hear and your belief in the plot against you at work are connected, and do the voices ever comment on your thoughts or actions outside of the plot?\n\nPatient: They feel deeply connected because the whispering voices specifically say I'm screwing things up and don't deserve my job, which really reinforces my belief that there is a plan to get me fired.
